_comment: One object per EXTERNAL vendor. Copy this file to dp_accounts.json (NOT in git, chmod 600) and point DEALER_PORTAL_ACCOUNTS_FILE at it. Own stock (Bijwasan / Mansarovar / Jaipur) must NOT be listed here at all -- that stock comes OUT of Dealer Portal, so pushing it back would double it.
password: <paste here, chmod 600, never in git or chat>
_vendors_note: Every spelling of this vendor as it appears in ProcureHub. Matched as whole words, so 'Northend' also catches 'Northend Distributors' and 'Northend Auto', but never 'Northendura'. An exact vendor_code such as 'NS_CT' works too. DP dealer_id 29 -- for your reference only; it is never sent, DP reads the dealer from the login token.
_full_snapshot_note: false = sold-out parts are detected and logged but NOT zeroed in DP. Set true ONLY for a vendor confirmed to send a COMPLETE daily list -- on a partial file, true would wipe their real DP stock.
